entities.paper: BERT-Based Multi-Head Selection for Joint Entity-Relation Extraction

bert_feature_layer.text: BERT is adopted as a feature extraction layer at the bottom of the multi-head selection framework, replacing BiLSTM.

enhanced_pre_training_named.text: The conclusion names "enhanced BERT pre-training" as one of the three main technologies introduced to improve performance, alongside soft label embedding and NER pre-training.

crf_on_bert.text: For the named entity recognition task, a linear-chain CRF is built on top of BERT, with the score function being BERT's output at each character.

ner_pretraining_corpus.text: A large-scale Baidu Baike corpus is introduced for entity recognition pre-training, which is weakly supervised since there are no actual named entity labels.

multihead_relation_prediction.text: Relation classification is formulated as multi-head selection, and a multi-sigmoid layer is used for relation prediction since the same entity pair may have multiple relations, with cross-entropy loss minimized during training.

single_model_f1.text: With a single model, the approach achieves an F1-score of 0.876 on testset-1.

ensemble_f1.text: By ensembling four variants of the model, the paper reports F1 score 0.892 (1st place) on testset-1 and F1 score 0.8924 (2nd place) on testset-2.

bert_as_feature_layer.text: 该论文将 BERT 作为特征提取层置于 multi-head selection 框架的底部，替代原工作中的 BiLSTM，用于为每个字符提取上下文特征。

semantic_enhanced_pretraining.text: 为进一步优化 BERT，作者在 BERT 预训练阶段引入了一个语义增强（semantic-enhanced）任务。

three_improvements_summary.text: 结论将增强的 BERT 预训练、soft label embedding 和 NER 预训练列为提升性能的三项主要技术。

soft_label_embedding.text: 论文提出 soft label embedding，用于在实体识别与关系抽取之间有效传递信息；关系分类中，第 i 个 token 的 soft label embedding 被送入两个独立全连接层，得到 subject 表示与 object 表示。

multi_head_relation_prediction.text: 关系分类被建模为 multi-head selection 问题（同一 token 可有多个 head，即与其他多个 token 存在关系）；由于同一实体对可能有多个关系，采用 multi-sigmoid 层进行关系预测，并在训练中最小化交叉熵损失 L_rel。

reported_results.text: 单模型在 testset-1 上取得 F1 0.876；集成四个模型变体后，最终在 testset-1 上取得 F1 0.892（第 1 名），在 testset-2 上取得 F1 0.8924（第 2 名）。

problem_motivation.text: 作者分析问题后发现大多数实体参与多个三元组，因此将 BERT 融入 multi-head selection 框架以进行联合实体-关系抽取。
